description: Read or write the working context: active topics and open items. With no change field it reads (written:false) everything: each open item whole with due and done_when, and recently closed. A write returns what changed and the counts (return_context:true for the whole context). Scope: this connection's project plus global items; scope=all spans every project. resolve_pending closes items (the last 15 stay in recently_closed); discard_pending drops them without recording them as done. Prefer ids. Nothing is deleted by age. Sessions are logged by crbro_consolidate.

add_pending.description: An open item, checkable later. Identical text is deduplicated; re-adding updates due and done_when.

clear.description: Empty topics, open and closed items (of the project only, when scoped), before the rest.

discard_pending.description: Drop items, same matcher, without recording them as done.

done_when.description: With add_pending: an observable completion condition.

due.description: With add_pending: a calendar day YYYY-MM-DD, only when agreed.

project.description: Project id or alias; default the boot project.

resolve_pending.description: Close items by id ("p_ab12cd") or 8+ characters of their text; several can match. Empty resolved = no match.

return_context.description: With a write: return the whole context instead of the change and counts.

set_topics.description: Replace the active topics with these neuron ids.

name: crbro_context
title: Working context
